_comment: The browser smoke suite CI runs on every PR (the `browser` job in
.github/workflows/test.yml). It is deliberately much shorter than the full
/ui-validation loop: pages/ and theme/ are ~34k lines that the pytest suite
does not cover at all, and their Vue/Quasar slot templates run client-side,
so a bad `props.row.foo` in a table slot renders blank and no Python test
can see it. This list is the set of surfaces where that failure would cost
the most, not an attempt at coverage.
Targets address a tab by URL section (/home/<slug>, /admin/<slug>) rather
than clicking a label, so the tab's content is built during the initial
Runs against the seeded `default` tenant, which has every feature flag on,
so gated surfaces (brackets, qualifiers, equipment, volunteers) are
reachable here. The flag-OFF direction is scripts/ui_flag_sweep.sh's job and
Adding a target costs ~3s of CI. Add one when a surface becomes somewhere a
blank render would go unnoticed until an event; do not mirror every tab.
